cohort: 56 mothers who gave birth at Lombok 22 Hospital Surabaya and also had done Early Initiation of Breastfeeding (EIBF)
finding: Breast milk production was lower in mothers who delivered by caesarean section compared to vaginal delivery, and this relationship was influenced by postpartum pain and anxiety.
mod_finding: Breast milk production was lower in mothers who delivered by caesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
